integrity: The proof derives the exact conditional expected-residual matrix, gives a necessary-and-sufficient fixed-matrix semidefinite criterion, reduces the fixed-condition-number family to one rotation parameter, and constructs an equality family. The packaged checker replays exact finite identities but is not used to replace the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an exact-arithmetic, one-step, two-dimensional result for SPD systems with coordinate probabilities proportional to A_ii. It concerns the Euclidean equation residual and does not classify higher dimensions, uniform sampling with unequal diagonals, asynchronous or delayed variants, block coordinates, greedy selection, finite precision, or multi-step path maxima.
title: One plus root two is the sharp expected-residual frontier for two-coordinate randomized Gauss–Seidel
